How to Play 3Patti Master?

The rules of 3Patti Master are simple and easy to grasp. The game begins with each player receiving three cards face-down. The objective is to have the best hand compared to other players at the table. The ranking of hands is similar to traditional Poker, with the highest combination being a Trail (three of the same rank), followed by a Pure Sequence, Sequence, Color, Pair, and High Card.

Players place their bets based on the strength of their hands and can choose to continue playing or fold if they feel their cards aren’t strong enough. Bluffing and strategy play a crucial role in winning the game, making it an exciting challenge for everyone.
